format: Single "Core" Panera Bread Bakery-Cafe (approx. 3,200 to 3,500 sq ft) in a non-urban market, excluding real estate and landlord allowances; Panera primarily sells multi-unit Area Development Agreements (minimum 2 cafes)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Panera Bread Bakery-Cafe in the "Core" format ranges from $1,337,139 to $4,569,880 (excluding real estate and related costs, and landlord allowances), including an initial franchise fee of $50,000 and various initial fees and payments of up to $300,000 payable to us for certain optional development and construction services.

fee.quote: If you do not sign an Area Development Agreement, then the initial franchise fee for a Core Bakery-Cafe or Small Box Bakery-Cafe is $50,000, which is due and payable when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Under an Area Development Agreement (minimum 2 cafes) the Development Fee is $50,000 x number of cafes, credited so no separate franchise fee is due. Non-Traditional Bakery-Cafe fee is 50% (currently $25,000). In fiscal 2025 Panera collected initial franchise fees ranging from $12,500 to $35,000 and development fees from $15,000 to $20,000. Optional Development Services and Real Estate Selection/Construction Management services are $150,000 each.

royalty.quote: Royalty 5% of Net Sales Payable on 1st business day immediately following each "Reporting Period"

adFund.quote: National Advertising Fund ("NAF") ... 4% of Net Sales for standard Panera Bread Bakery-Cafes; 2.6% of Net Sales for Non-Traditional Bakery-Cafes. Local Advertising Funds ("LAF") 2.0% of Net Sales ... Marketing Administration Fee ("MAF") 0.4% of Net Sales
adFund.note: NAF 4% + MAF 0.4% + LAF 2.0% local spend (through fiscal 2026 franchisees may temporarily reduce LAF to 0.5%). NAF increases require a vote of 66% of all cafes or 51% of franchised cafes.

otherRecurring.name: Cafe Technology with Drive Thru (3 POS; BOH; Help Desk)
otherRecurring.amount: $425 - $500 monthly per Bakery-Cafe ($385 - $410 without Drive Thru)

transferFee.amount: $25,000 for the transfer of a Bakery-Cafe under the Franchise Agreement.

special: Panera primarily offers multi-unit Area Development Agreements (minimum 2 cafes; Development Fee $100,000 for 2), single-unit franchises only in certain situations. Panera may sell franchisees cafes it develops at total development cost plus a Development Fee (currently $150,000). If you own the premises, Panera may require a lease option or a prime lease/sublease with Panera at fair market rent. EBITDA margin is company-owned and excludes the 5% royalty and initial fee amortization a franchisee would pay.
issues: Cover gives only the $50,000 fee plus 'up to $300,000' optional services paid to Panera; no single printed total, so toFranchisorHigh left null. Item 19 prints no median for franchisee-owned cafes. Item 20 includes Non-Traditional Locations.
